# Synthesis Summary — Year in Review Fixture

## Top Findings

Annual retrospective of European Parliament legislative output for 2025: coalition evolution, dossier throughput scorecard, mandate fulfilment progress, and cumulative political-risk trajectory across four quarters.

## Annual Retrospective

2025 delivered the highest plenary throughput since EP9 inauguration: 194 roll-call votes, 31 adopted texts, and 8 trilogues concluded. The EPP-S&D-Renew centrist coalition held cohesion above 78 % across all major files.

## Mandate Fulfilment Scorecard

Commission Work Programme 2025 completion rate reached 74 % by December — above the 68 % mid-term benchmark. Priority shortfalls identified in social policy (gender-pay directive delayed) and housing (no standalone legislative proposal).

## Cumulative Risk Trajectory

Political-risk aggregate rose from baseline 3.1 (Q1) to 4.7 (Q4) driven by trade defence activation and defence spending coalition fractures. Year-on-year risk delta: +1.6 points.
